name: olio.pb.sceneActor
label: Scene actor
description: PictureBook V3 §8 scene actor: one figure placed in an olio.pb.composition - a cast character (character FK) or an unnamed extra / crowd (character null, description + count). Carries the narrative role, the priority the composer orders references by (default derived from the role; reads 0 on legacy rows), the apparel worn, pose / expression / action / facing text and enum, a normalized box (x, y, w, h in 0-1 image space), depth (0 = front), and the reference policy. Rows live in the book's group, owned by the request user, and are found by the 'composition' FK - never a list on the composition. Deleted with the book by PbDeleteUtil. No field carries a schema default (PB2 convention rule 3, TestPbModelSchema): enum columns read NULL as UNKNOWN, numbers read 0 on legacy rows.

fields.name: character
fields.description: The cast member this actor is; null for an unnamed extra or a crowd.

fields.name: priority
fields.description: Reference-slot and prompt-budget order within the composition; the composer derives the default from the role. Reads 0 on legacy rows.

fields.name: apparel
fields.description: The outfit worn in this frame; nullable - the character's current apparel applies when unset.

fields.name: action
fields.description: What this actor is doing, as distinct from the composition's overall action.

fields.name: x
fields.description: Left edge of the actor's box, normalized 0-1 of image width.

fields.name: y
fields.description: Top edge of the actor's box, normalized 0-1 of image height.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-text description, required when character is null (an extra or a crowd).

fields.name: count
fields.description: How many figures this row stands for; 1 for a single actor, more for a crowd. Reads 0 on legacy rows.
